sigma_reg_z_basis: RMS of the per-skylight vertical rim residuals of the gravity-preserving 4-DOF FAST-LIO constellation solve (flf_registration_report.json): [np.float64(0.0), np.float64(-1.07), np.float64(1.55)] m. The 4-DOF (yaw+translation) solve keeps the map z-axis aligned to gravity; the residual is the real non-coplanarity of the three skylight rims between the surface model and the interior map. (The DLIO 6-DOF solve reached 0.03 m only by an unphysical 47 deg roll about the near-collinear skylight axis.)
sigma_lidar_basis: Ouster range precision (~3 cm) plus aggregated-map surface thickness (~10 cm at the 10 cm voxel working copy).
sigma_dem_basis: ASSUMED photogrammetric DEM vertical accuracy ~2x GSD; UPDATE when Birgir supplies survey metadata (gate G1).
final_transform: flf_transform_landmark.json (FAST-LIO first-flight, 4-DOF gravity-preserving constellation). Replaces the DLIO transform_landmark.json after the DLIO map was found to carry ~60 m vertical drift (dlio_vs_fastlio_drift.py).
